items.title: STEDI: Pre-Diagnostic Screening Assistant for Elderly Health Posts
items.org: Ministry of Education & EPICS in IEEE
items.desc:
• Successfully advanced the team's innovation to the National Finals of the 38th Pekan Ilmiah Mahasiswa Nasional (PIMNAS) under the Student Creativity Program for Innovative Works (PKM-KI).
• Scaled the project to an international level, securing a US$3,150 humanitarian technology grant from EPICS in IEEE (Jon C. Taenzer Memorial Fund).
• Officially registered as a co-inventor in the Industrial Design Intellectual Property Rights (HKI) for the STEDI Monitor Box physical device.

items.title: E-Growth: Digital Growth Monitoring Platform
items.desc:
• Developed the functional components of E-Growth, a cloud-based platform integrated with the F-Scale pediatric measurement device.
• Implemented digital monitoring and visualization of child growth parameters and foot-arch analysis for early detection of flat foot and cavus foot.
• Supported field implementation at kindergarten/TK Ainun Habibie, enabling approximately 100 students' growth and foot-structure measurements to be digitally reported and monitored.

items.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
items.desc:
